_note: The third frozen set: the eight scenarios of dataset 2.2. Earlier suites
are unchanged; published numbers cite whichever suite they were computed
Coverage is 55 of 56 combinations: pack_gift_hand is a single-camera
embodiment, so view_match has no questions there; the empty dimension is
kept and reported as n/a rather than dropped.
pack_gift_gim supersedes its dataset-2.0 form: the scenario was
regenerated whole with 50 episodes (the original 25 plus 25 new ones),
so its scores under this suite are not comparable with suite v1.
